Pre-existing structural tests (screen-record-detail.test.jsx, screen-app-records.test.jsx) encoded fixed-offset source slices (e.g. src.slice(idx, idx+2000)) sized for the OLD implementation; adding the new preview/download-error state fields pushed later assertions past the slice boundary, causing false failures unrelated to behavior. Two eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/anchor-is-valid comments I initially added triggered 'Definition for rule ... was not found' errors, because this repo's eslint.config.js never registers the jsx-a11y or react-hooks plugins (a pre-existing gap; screen-reports.jsx already carries one stale react-hooks/exhaustive-deps disable comment predating this task). Removed the two new jsx-a11y comments (zero benefit, pure noise); left the pre-existing pattern elsewhere untouched.

authed-file.test.js's downloadFile success test left a dangling setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(...), 0) that fired AFTER afterEach() deleted the URL stub, producing an 'unhandled error: URL.revokeObjectURL is not a function' even though all assertions passed. Fixed by awaiting one macrotask tick at the end of that test before the stub teardown runs.
